title: Readable task scorecard CLI output
description:
Improve only format_scorecard(report) in milestone2/scorecard.py and add tests/test_scorecard_format.py. Preserve all imports, collector/quality/numeric helpers, --json output, native authority, dependencies and permissions. No services, containers, live backend writes, task/agent configuration changes or new abstractions. Record the starting Git commit. Write tests first, observe RED, implement, run targeted tests and the full credential-free suite, commit the two allowed files, and hand off through the existing native policy.

The formatter must return readable text without mutating the report or dumping arbitrary fields. Contract (unformatted integer counts; timing in seconds with 3 decimal places; USD with 6 decimal places; None is unknown, never zero):
Task: <identifier or issueId> (<status>)
Owner accepted: <yes/no>
Independent participants: <yes/no/unknown>
Gates: <completedStages>/<totalStages>
Runs: <runCount>; failed: <failedRuns>; retries: <recordedRetries>; handoff cancellations: <handoffCancellations>
Runtime: <runtimeMs/1000 or unknown> s; coverage: <timing.coveredRuns>/<runCount>
Execution window: <executionWindowMs/1000 or unknown> s
Known runtime subtotal: <knownRuntimeMs/1000> s
Tokens: input <inputTokens or unknown>; cached <cachedInputTokens or unknown>; output <outputTokens or unknown>; coverage: <usage.coveredRuns>/<runCount>
Reported cost: <reportedCostUsd or unknown> USD; coverage: <costCoveredRuns>/<runCount>
Known subtotal: input <knownInputTokens>; cached <knownCachedInputTokens>; output <knownOutputTokens>; reported <knownReportedCostUsd> USD
Reported cost per owner-accepted task: <reportedCostPerOwnerAcceptedTaskUsd or unknown> USD
Caution: include non-atomic readback, declared participant separation is not execution proof, native reported cost is not invoice evidence, and correctness requires independent validation/review/QA.

Cover unknown vs explicit zero, complete/partial usage, partial timing, pending owner approval, unknown/non-independent participants, identifier fallback, and no mutation/private-field dumping. The independent presentation contract is milestone4/fixtures/scorecard_qa.py; you may read but must not edit it. Run PYTHONPATH=/paperclip/m1-python-libs:$PWD python3 -m unittest tests.test_scorecard_format tests.test_scorecard -q and the complete suite.

Reviewer: review the entire new scorecard foundation relative to 3da27d685977ceb1c69074996b6b83260c54bfc5 as well as this candidate formatter. Inspect milestone2/task.py, milestone2/scorecard.py, tests/test_scorecard.py and the milestone4 fixtures for scope, unknown-vs-zero accounting, privacy, activity/run scoping and non-atomic limitations. The deterministic presentation QA may use a small synthetic report without optional explanatory quality keys; support the documented field contract. Do not modify any files or treat declared stage independence as proof of executed review. Use the native Validator's exact commit/tree and issue evidence for your decision. Owner approval remains required before integration.
